apps.name: Beacon Finance
apps.whats_new:
48.22.1  (November 2026)  UPDATES NO LONGER STUCK ON THE CLOSING SYNC
  - Help → Update now no longer gets stuck on the closing sync: when the program closes for an update it asks no "Close anyway?" questions (changes not yet synced stay on this computer and go at the next sync), the closing sync gets at most 5 minutes, the program then ends for sure, and the update waits up to 3 hours for it (it gave up after 15 minutes before, so nothing was installed or opened again).
  - This version must be installed by hand once (the one before closes the old way).
